description: Parking - Edmonton Insight Community is a dataset listed in City of Edmonton open data portal (data.edmonton.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Edmonton. This was one single topic among many as part of the February 2016 Mixed Topic survey. To view the survey questions, click on the following link: Open from February 08 - 16, 2016. At the time the survey was launched survey invitations were sent to 4537 Insight Community Members. Coverage: Edmonton. The portal files it under the category Surveys. Its tags are 2016, parking, insight. The table has 74 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Edmonton. The portal shows 2016-09-13 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-edmonton-ca-portal.
